explanations.topic: Modifying an object through one reference variable affects all other references to the same object.
explanations.explanation_text: Changing a field (e.g., `point1.x = 2;`) updates the single underlying object. Since `point2` references the same object, reading `point2.x` will reflect the updated value.

examples.content:

```java
Point point1 = new Point(1, 1);
Point point2 = point1; // point2 references the same object
point1.x = 2; // modify via point1
System.out.println(point2.x); // prints 2, showing the change is visible
```
